name: ExtractInvoiceData
description: Invoice Matching exercise: reads a supplier invoice PDF from storage bucket InvoicesStorage with the IXP project InvoicesIXP and returns it as JSON in the exercise's invoice shape, plus the purchase-order number it references. Provided by the course; participants never build it.

input.name: in_InvoiceFileName
input.tooltip: The invoice PDF's name in storage bucket InvoicesStorage (folder Tools), e.g. INV-22150825.pdf — the generator's out_InvoiceFileName.

output.name: out_InvoiceJSON
output.tooltip: The invoice as JSON text in the exercise's invoice shape (invoiceNumber, poNumber, invoiceDate, dueDate, currency, vendor, buyer, lines[], subtotal, taxName, taxRate, taxTotal, total), as IXP read it from the PDF.

output.name: out_PONumber
output.tooltip: The purchase-order number IXP read from the invoice, PO-<8 digits>, for the PurchaseOrders lookup.

output.name: out_InvoiceNumber
output.tooltip: The invoice number IXP read from the invoice, INV-<8 digits>.
